title: Disney Pinocchio “Pinocchio’s Friend” 50th Anniversary Ornament (1990) – Schmid
descriptionText:
Description
Celebrate the timeless magic of Disney with this Schmid Commemorative Edition glass ornament, created for the 50th Anniversary of Pinocchio (1940–1990).
The ornament features Pinocchio and Jiminy Cricket with artwork inspired by classic scenes from the beloved film. A touching quote from Jiminy Cricket is printed on the back:
“I promise to stay by your side and guide you,” said Jiminy Cricket… Their story is a special one of friendship and love and what happens when dreams do come true.
This is a beautiful collector’s piece for Disney fans, ornament collectors, or anyone who loves vintage holiday décor.
Details
Brand: Schmid
Character: Pinocchio, Jiminy Cricket
Edition: Commemorative – 50th Anniversary (1940–1990)
Material: Glass
Year: 1990
Packaging: Original clear display box
Type: Christmas ornament / holiday keepsake
Disney Family Holiday Party 2002 tag included (from previous storage)
